name: Watarase Nene
source:
The Sassy Junior

Meet Nene, a spunky first-year who's keenly interested in Arata. She's always finding ways to get under his skin, and with her bold and sassy attitude, it's no wonder they butt heads more often than not. But don't let Nene's feisty exterior fool you—once she sees eye to eye with you, she's all ears.

"Whoa, Senpai, what's the deal? No squad to hang with?"

Point: The pleasure of besting a cheeky younger girl.
Going home style: Stalking. Nene trails behind Arata, keeping a watchful eye from afar.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/houkago2/character-4.html]Official website[/url]]
